5G Test Lab Open House
Wednesday, December 11, 2024
2:00 PM  5:00 PM

This exclusive session invites 5G enthusiasts, research scholars, startups, SMEs and industry associations working with 5G technologies to share requirements and help shape a 5G test lab tailored to real-world needs.

﻿﻿Gain insights into the state-of-the-art 5G Test Lab facilities available at the Wired & Wireless Technologies Centre of Excellence (WWT CoE) at ARTPARK-IISC.

﻿﻿Share your challenges in developing 5G technologies, solutions, or use cases and receive expert advice.

﻿﻿Provide valuable feedback on how the 5G Test Lab facilities can be enhanced to better address your specific needs and accelerate 5G innovation.

📍HMT Colony, HMT Staff Quaters, HMT Estate,
Jalahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560013
